interview.secured: "Day secured" means I finished every task for today, so today counts toward my streak (the app says this right at the top of the home screen).
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is in anything I saw, so I don't know; I'd only be guessing that it saves a streak.
interview.selfReported: The app never spelled it out, but it's shown under my pushups post, so I assume it means I just said I did it and nothing verified it.
interview.tomorrow: 7 - Kim invited me and the 1-task day was quick, and I want to see day 2 of the streak, but I'm not sure yet what else the app offers.

goals.text: The invite opened Kim's challenge: accept it and join. Then find Kim's proof post on the challenge or in the feed. Like it, double-tap the photo, and leave a one-line comment. Then tap Kim's name to open the profile.
